La laterale fa vedere le zone che nella: The lateral view shows the areas hidden on the PA behind the heart, behind the domes and in front of the mediastinum. Read them in order: retrosternal space (in front of the ascending aorta: it must be clear; it fills with anterior mediastinal masses), retrocardiac space (behind the heart: it must be clear), spine (going down, the vertebrae get darker; if they get lighter there is a lower lobe opacity, «spine sign»), posterior costophrenic angles (the first to fill with fluid: about 50 ml is enough), fissures (a thickened or displaced fissure indicates fluid or volume loss), hila and the tracheal air column. In COVID-19 the X-ray is often normal in the first days: a normal X-ray does not exclude the disease.
Nella laterale: retrosternale, retrocard: On the lateral: retrosternal, retrocardiac, spine darkening downwards, posterior angles.
